blurb: SunnyCider produces craft ciders using a blend of Calgary urban apples and Okanagan apple juice, with some local fruit integration. They operate a taproom in Calgary and distribute to liquor stores and bars across Alberta. Their products have won multiple Alberta Beverage Awards and GLINTCAP medals.
